title: Two Sum
author: openarena
statement: The first line of stdin holds two integers: N, the length of the array, and T, the target. The second line holds N integers. Exactly one pair of them sums to T. Print the two 0-based indices of that pair in ascending order, separated by one space.

title: Balanced Brackets
author: openarena
statement: The first line of stdin holds an integer N. Each of the next N lines is a string of brackets drawn from ()[]{}. For each line print YES if the brackets are balanced and correctly nested, otherwise NO — one answer per line.

title: Roman Numerals
author: openarena
statement: The first line of stdin holds an integer N. Each of the next N lines is a Roman numeral between I and MMMCMXCIX. Print its integer value, one per line.

title: Word Frequency
author: openarena
statement: Read all of stdin. A word is a maximal run of letters, compared case-insensitively. Print the three most frequent words, most frequent first, breaking ties alphabetically. Print one per line as `word count`, the word lowercased. If there are fewer than three distinct words, print all of them.

tests.name: sentence
tests.stdin: the quick brown fox the lazy dog the fox

tests.name: letters
tests.stdin: a b b c c c

tests.name: punctuation and case
tests.stdin: Hello, hello! World world WORLD? yes

title: Implement a Stack
author: openarena
statement: Write a class Stack with methods push(x), pop(), peek(), size() and is_empty(). pop() and peek() on an empty stack must raise IndexError. Your file is saved as solution.py and imported by the graders, so define the class at module level and print nothing on import.

tests.name: basics
tests.program:
from solution import Stack
s = Stack()
assert s.is_empty()
s.push(1); s.push(2); s.push(3)
assert s.size() == 3
assert s.peek() == 3
assert s.pop() == 3
assert s.pop() == 2
assert s.size() == 1
assert not s.is_empty()
print('ok')

tests.name: empty raises IndexError
holds any value
tests.program:
from solution import Stack
s = Stack()
for v in ['a', 2, None, (1, 2)]:
    s.push(v)
assert s.size() == 4
assert s.pop() == (1, 2)
assert s.pop() is None
assert s.peek() == 2
print('ok')
